provenance.instrument: Code of the Township of Lower Paxton, Chapter 203 Zoning, as published on eCode360
provenance.status_detail: eCode360 (code LO1649): includes legislation through 05-19-2025. New Laws lists Ord. 2026-02, Zoning Amendment, adopted 2026-05-20 and not yet codified. Its text was read. It changes boarding house and garage sale rules, porches, age-restricted development and storage building height. It does not mention accessory dwelling units.
provenance.code_current_through_note: eCode360: Includes legislation through 05-19-2025. Ord. 2026-02 (adopted 2026-05-20) is listed under New Laws.
checks: The code allows ADUs by right in many districts but sets almost no ADU standards. 203-314A asks only for a building permit, a certificate of use and occupancy, and Codes Department inspections
No size cap, owner-occupancy rule, family rule, number limit or ADU parking rule was found. Ask the township before relying on that
Accessory structures may not exceed the height of the main house (203-313H)
Accessory structures need 5 ft from side and rear lot lines and may not sit in the required front yard (203-313C). The district table may set larger yards for a unit attached to the house (203-313B)
On residential lots under 2 acres, all accessory buildings together may not exceed 1,000 sq ft, with at most two buildings (203-313G)
'No part of an accessory garage shall be occupied as a residential living area' (203-314C(2)). This may bar a unit in or over a detached garage
Carriage houses and flex flats (living space over a detached garage) are separate uses, permitted only in the Neighborhood Design District
R-2 and R-3 set lot area per dwelling unit for some uses. The code does not say whether an ADU counts
provenance.notes: Zoning office: Community Development Department, https://www.lowerpaxton-pa.gov/169/Community-Development. Pending: Ord. 2026-02 adopted 2026-05-20, not yet in the online code, does not touch ADUs. The definition of conversion dwelling says ADUs and in-law suites are 'primarily intended to house family members'. This is descriptive, not a use rule.

term.note: 'A separate and accessory living space that is attached or detached to the primary dwelling.'

status.note: 'Accessory dwelling units' marked P in CO, AR, R-1, R-2, R-3, V, CN, NDD and TC.

path.note: P means permitted by right. 203-314A requires a building permit for additions, a certificate of use and occupancy, and inspections.

fallback_path.note: 'Accessory uses and structures which are not specifically listed in the table shall not be permitted.' Reading: in IN, ON, CG, LI, GI and BC a variance would be needed.

zoning_districts.note: Table columns Conservation, Ag. Res., Low Den., Med. Den., Med./High, Village, Neighborhood Commercial, Neighborhood Design District and Towne Centre are P. District codes from 203-303.

min_lot_sqft.note: No ADU lot size. District minimum lot areas apply to the lot.

existing_structure_only.note: 'attached or detached to the primary dwelling'. New construction is not barred.

historic_bypass.note: No historic rule in the ADU text. 203-306 covers historic buildings generally.

types_allowed.note: Reading: 'attached or detached to the primary dwelling'. Garage forms left out because 'No part of an accessory garage shall be occupied as a residential living area'.

max_sqft.note: No ADU size cap found. See accessory building floor area cap.

max_height_ft.note: 'Accessory structures shall not exceed the height of the principal structure'. No fixed number.

setback_front_ft.note: Accessory structures 'shall not be located in the required front yard'. See districts.

setback_side_ft.note: 'All accessory structures shall be set back a minimum of five feet from any side or rear property line'. The district row may apply instead to a dwelling unit.

setback_rear_ft.note: 5 ft for accessory structures. The district row may apply instead to a dwelling unit.

max_building_coverage.note: Varies by district: R-1 30%, R-2 50%, R-3 60%. Accessory structures count toward lot coverage.

max_impervious.note: Varies by district: R-1 40%, R-2 60%, R-3 70%.

owner_occupancy.note: No owner-occupancy rule found in the ADU text.

family_only.note: No family rule. The conversion dwelling definition says ADUs are 'primarily intended to house family members'. Descriptive only.

short_term_rental_banned.note: Not addressed in the ADU text.

max_adus.note: No number limit found. The table row reads 'Accessory dwelling units'.

spaces_required.note: No ADU parking row found in a text search of Chapter 203.

min_lot_sqft.note: With public water and sewer. 39,000 with one of them. 43,560 with neither.

setback_side_ft.note: One side yard 10 ft min, both together 25 ft min.

principal_max_height_ft.note: '3 stories or 40 feet, whichever is more restrictive'

min_lot_sqft.note: Single-family detached with public water and sewer. 43,560 without both.

setback_side_ft.note: One side yard 5 ft min, both together 15 ft min.

principal_max_height_ft.note: '3 stories or 40 feet, whichever is more restrictive'

min_lot_sqft.note: Single-family detached with public water and sewer. 43,560 without both.

setback_side_ft.note: 5 ft for single-family detached with public water and sewer.

principal_max_height_ft.note: '3 stories or 40 feet, whichever is more restrictive'
